ask: Art-direct "Gethsemane Olive Dusk" — #1 of the 72 Ambo church visualizers (Calm Contemporary Worship lyric visualizer, Collection I of 72; subgenre Scenic Nature). Premise: Ancient gnarled olive boughs, Jerusalem terrace stones, and lantern fireflies. Interactive code twin of the Gethsemane concept plate: gnarled thousand-year olive trunks, silver-sage foliage, terraced limestone walls, and hanging oil lanterns breathe with the singer’s voice. Lighting today: Key: 3200K warm oil-lantern glow + 5800K indigo twilight sky; rolling ground haze. Service use: Communion, Good Friday, intimate reflection, acoustic worship. Audio mapping today: Vocal → Brightens hanging oil lanterns, firefly halos & lyric glow; Swell → Lifts warm amber ground mist through ancient olive roots; Harmonic → Sways silver-green olive leaf clusters in the evening breeze. Palette: #09131E #1E3A4C #D49B42 #FAF3E3. Keep the id, name, premise and palette; rebuild the direction: the geometry and depth planes, typography for the worship lyric band (one line at a time, four to five seconds a line, word-by-word progression), image logic (how the Gemini concept plate it twins (/sanctuary-plates/calm-olive-gethsemane.jpg, blended in at plateBlend) and the procedural scene meet), texture, motion, and which audio channel drives what. Decide it — the lead's lens will drive the kit's material weave and optical pass for this one.
audience: Congregations watching a projector or LED wall from the pews, five to forty metres away, eyes on the words; and the worship leader or volunteer running Ambo live from a laptop.
feeling: Stillness and reverence — a sanctuary that breathes with the singer's voice; gorgeous, slow, never a screensaver.
constraints: Build method (fixed): a real-time Canvas 2D audio-reactive renderer in Plajah's worship visualizer kit — sanctuary background, multi-plane depth (god rays, motes, bokeh), the kit's Council optical pass (35mm light leaks, anamorphic flare, film grain, colour punch, and a tactile material weave keyed to the LEAD director's lens) and the kit's lyric / scripture typography engine. No video playback, no WebGL, no assets beyond the one concept plate.

Audio drives amplitude, colour, light, growth and glow only — never the position of the words. Envelopes are smoothed; nothing strobes or flashes (photosensitive-safe); uptempo pulses are spring-damped.

The reading band is sacred: lyrics or scripture must stay legible at 1920×1080 and 4K from the back pew, over the busiest moment of the scene. A text-safe dimming band is part of the kit; direct how the scene yields to it.

Typefaces are fixed to the kit's open-licensed set: Noto Serif (text serif), Outfit / Inter (sans), Cinzel (display), JetBrains Mono. Direct scale, case, tracking, measure and hierarchy, not new families.

Sacred imagery is used correctly and respectfully: biblical places and objects are specific and attributable, never costume; nothing denominational or branded; nothing that reads as a music video or a screensaver.
Runs at 60 fps on an integrated-GPU laptop driving a projector: favour layered gradients, cached textures and a few large shapes over particle storms.
Keep this visualizer's id, name, premise and four-colour palette. The council owns the direction, not the catalogue entry.
references: Concept plate: /sanctuary-plates/calm-olive-gethsemane.jpg — a Gemini art plate this visualizer was built as the interactive code twin of.
Sample lyric lines on the band: "Be still my soul the Lord is on thy side" / "Bear patiently the cross of grief or pain".
